results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level, just 0.2 miles from Ocean Beach. Most homes here were built around 1941, though the oldest dates back to 1908 [DataSF](https://data.sf.gov).

A few things nearby:
* **Patriotic Homes:** Two blocks east, builders gave model homes hopeful names before WWII halted construction; the Rainbow House (1941) and Freedom House (1942) are located at 42nd and 43rd Ave [Doelger Architecture](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php).
* **Shipwrecks:** About 0.3 miles southwest, the hull of the clipper ship *King Philip* (wrecked 1878) remains buried in the sand near Noriega and Ortega [NPS](https://home.nps.gov/goga/learn/historyculture/vestiges-shipwrecks.htm).
* **Old Photos:** The [OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org) archive has photographs pinned near your corner at 46th and Moraga.

Like every block here, yours sits on a thick layer of dune sand [USGS](https://pubs.usgs.gov/pp/0782/report.pdf).

Do you know any other stories about your block you'd like to share?

*   **East side:** 1st and 3rd Mondays, noon to 2pm (next: 2026-11-16)
